{{Quote|His code name is Phalanx. He has vital information on Hutt dealings with the Sith.|[[Jax Dumont]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Phalanx''' was the alias of a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of [[Stardogs]], a group of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] veterans that fought against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. When Phalanx was captured by the Empire on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], [[Jax Dumont]] tasked a Republic citizen to rescue him since he carried important information on the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel's]] dealings with the Empire.
